m920016.いえ、そんなに都合よくはいきません。\n大きくなる代わりに自我を失ってしまう……:
No, it's not that convenient.
When it makes you larger, you lose your will…
It's a defective— a cursed relic.
m920016.おのれ……戦いは数だ！\nそれを証明してやる！:
Damn… It's all about numbers in battle!
I'll prove it!
m920016.おのれ……！ しかし力自体は上がっているはず！\n戦いはパワーだ！ それを証明し:
Damn...!
Still, my power should've increased!
Battle is all about strength! I'll prove it!
m920016.おのれ、盗人め……。\nどこまで逃げるのじゃ！: Damn you, thief…! How far will you run?!
m920016.お前らと会ったのも縁じゃ。\r\nワシを助けてくれぬか？: It's fate that we've met. Will you aid me?
m920016.かつて魔物に追い詰められた私の先祖が\n生み出してしまった、過ちの一つなのです…: It's one of the mistakes my ancestor, who was cornered by monsters, created…
m920016.くっ……。ここまで追いかけてきたか。: Hmph... you actually chased me this far.
m920016.くっ、魔物……！\nこんなところで足止めされるわけには……！:
Damn, a monster…!
I can't afford to be stalled here!
m920016.この地鳴りは……！ \n王子、神器の力を得た魔物達が\nこちらに向かってくるよう:
This ground tremor...!
Prince, monsters empowered by the relic are heading this way.
m920016.この辺りで神器の力を感じます……。: I sense the relic's power around here…
m920016.この近くに神器の力を感じる……。\n早く取り戻さなくては！:
I can feel the relic's power nearby….
We have to get it back quickly!
m920016.これさえあれば、\n我が軍の力をもっと強大にする事ができる……！: With this, I can make my army even more powerful...!
m920016.さぁ、神器よ！ 私に力を貸すのだ！\nふぅううんっっ！！:
Come forth, relic! Lend me your power!
Fuuuuungh!!
m920016.さあ、もうわかったじゃろう。\r\nならばつべこべ言わず、ワシに力を貸すのじゃ。: Now you understand, don't you? Then stop dithering and lend me your strength.
m920016.さあ、奪われた神器を取り戻すのじゃ。\nいくぞ！: Alright, let's retrieve the stolen relic. Let's go!
m920016.さあ、新たなる同胞よ！\n人間どもを滅ぼすのだ……！:
Come on, my new comrades!
Let's wipe out those humans...!
m920016.じゃが、使い道を誤ればとても\r\n危険なものじゃ。: But misuse it, and it becomes terribly dangerous.
m920016.すぐそこまで迫ってきています！\n迎え撃ちましょう！:
They're closing in right now!
Let's meet them head-on!
m920016.それにしても暑い！\n日の光とはこんなにも暑いものか？: And it's so hot! Is sunlight really this scorching?
m920016.どうやら追ってくることが\n分かっていて、待ち伏せしていたようですね。: It seems they anticipated our pursuit and set up an ambush.
m920016.なんじゃ、この怪しい雰囲気は……。\n神器からあふれた力が渦巻いている！？:
What's with this ominous vibe…?
The relic's power is swirling everywhere!
m920016.なんだ……！？ なぜこんなに身体が重いのだ！\nこれでは戦いにくいではないか！:
What the—!? Why am I so heavy!
This makes fighting impossible!
m920016.なんだと……！？\nなぜこんなに脆いのだ！: What…?! Why is it so fragile?!
m920016.はあっ、はあっ、盗人め……！\nどこに逃げたのじゃ！: Hah! Hah! Thief…! Where did you run off to?!
m920016.はい……。実は、代々護ってきた神器が\n何者かに盗まれてしまったんです。: Well… Actually, the relic our ancestors have guarded for generations was stolen by someone.
m920016.ふふふ、この神器の力があれば\n我々の力は強大となる。: Heh, with this relic's power, our strength will become overwhelming.
m920016.ふふふ、これは強力な道具を手に入れたぞ……。\n大きくするだけではなく……。:
Hehe… I've gotten hold of a powerful tool…
It doesn't just make things bigger…
m920016.ふふふ、巨大になったぞ……！\nさぁ、お前達を踏みつぶ………む？:
Heh heh, I'm huge now...!
Now I'll crush you all... huh?
m920016.まさか人間に神器を……！？\nそんなことをすれば正気を失ってしまいます！:
No way— humans would use the relic…!?
If they do, they'll lose their sanity!
m920016.もう後には引けぬ。\nかくなる上は私自身が巨大化して……！:
There's no turning back now.
If it comes to this, I'll enlarge myself...!
m920016.やめなさい！ それは呪われた神器。\n周りだけじゃない、あなた自身も不幸に\nす:
Stop! That's a cursed relic.
It won't just harm those around you—it'll bring misfortune to you too!
m920016.グルル……。\nニンゲンのこどもミつけた。: Grrr… I've caught a human child.
m920016.ワシはドワーフのビショップノエルじゃ。\r\nこれでも最高位の神官である。\r\: I'm Bishop Noel of the dwarves. Even so, I'm the highest-ranking priest. My head's held high, you know?
m920016.一応、助けてくれたことには礼を言おう。\r\nじゃが、ワシは子供ではない。: I'll at least thank you for rescuing me. …but I'm no child.
m920016.何が起きるかわからんぞ！\n気をつけるのじゃ！:
We have no idea what might happen!
Stay on your guard!
m920016.刻水晶のことはお前らも知っておるようじゃし、\r\nワシからの説明は必要ないじゃ: You already know about the engraved crystal, so I won't bother you with an explanation.
m920016.助かった、この国の軍隊ね。\nあのー！ 助けてくださーい！:
Thank goodness, it's the kingdom's troops.
Um—please, help us!
m920016.地下暮らしには堪えるな。: Living underground really takes its toll.
m920016.地下深くに暮らすドワーフにとって、\r\nとても重要なものなのじゃ。: For us dwarves who live deep underground, it's incredibly important.
m920016.増やすものが作物ならば害はない。\r\nじゃが、危険な魔物を増やすことが\r\n: If it only boosts crops, there's no harm. Yet if it could spawn dangerous monsters…
m920016.女の人が襲われているようです！\n王子、助けましょう！:
A woman seems to be under attack!
Prince, let's rescue her!
m920016.実は先日、わが神殿に盗人が入り、\r\n神殿に保管していた大切な神器と\r\n刻: Actually, a thief broke into my temple the other day and stole the precious relic and the engraved crystal we kept there. The culprit was a White Goblin.
m920016.念じるだけで大きくなるなんて……。\nそんなものがあれば、魔物との戦いで\nどれ: To grow just by willing it… If we had something like that, imagine how much it would help in battles against monsters…
m920016.愚かな……。\n神器の力の使いすぎじゃ。\n蓄えた力を使い果たしておる。: Foolish… You've overused the relic's power. You've exhausted its stored energy.
m920016.本当にありがとうございます。\n助かりました……。:
Thank you so much.
You saved me…
m920016.王子、子供が魔物に襲われています！\n早く助けましょう！: Prince, a child's being attacked by a goblin! Let's rescue them quickly!
m920016.王子、巨大な魔物が出現しているという\n場所はここです。: Prince, this is the spot where the huge monster appeared.
m920016.王子！ 巨大な兵士達が\nこちらに向かっているという\n報告が……。: Prince! Reports say massive soldiers are heading this way…
m920016.知った事か！ さぁ、我が同胞達よ！\n人間共を撲滅するのだ……！:
Who cares! Come, my comrades!
Let's exterminate those humans...!
m920016.確かに危険な道具のようですね。\n王子、彼女に力を貸してさしあげましょう！:
It certainly sounds like a dangerous device.
Prince, let's lend her our aid!
m920016.神器の力を感じる……。\nついに追い詰めたぞ！: I can feel the relic's power… We've finally cornered them!
m920016.神器の反応はこの洞窟です。\n恐らく、周辺の魔物に神器を使って\n待ち構えている:
The relic's reaction is in this cave.
Likely the nearby monsters are using the relic to lie in wait.
m920016.神器は豊穣の杖といって\r\n作物の収穫を増やすことができる\r\nありがたいも: The relic is called the Staff of Bounty—it can increase crop yields, a truly blessed thing.
m920016.私は神器の力を感じ、追うことができます。\nお願いです。どうか私と共に、神器の捜:
I can sense the relic's power and track it.
Please, could you help me search for the relic?
m920016.頭数だけは増えたようじゃが、\n見た目だけのハリボテじゃの。: Their numbers may have swelled, but they're just a hollow shell.

m920021.あとヌルヌルが気持ち悪くて……。\nひっ！ こっちに来ます！: And they're disgustingly slippery… Yikes! One's coming this way!
m920021.あなたの行為は世界を道づれにするだけです。\n世界の為、おとなしく死んでいただく: Your actions will only lead the world further astray. For the sake of the world, you should quietly die.
m920021.あなた方の首を差し出せば人々を無闇に\nしいたげることは止めると言っているのです: They say that if you hand over your heads, they'll stop the needless cruelty against the people.
m920021.あれはローパーです！\nあんなにたくさん……。: That's a looper! So many of them…
m920021.おやめください。\n確かにあなたは愚かだったかもしれません。\nですがこれ以上愚: Please stop. You may indeed have been foolish, but do you really intend to keep doing something even more foolish?
m920021.ここで何者かの襲撃を受けているとのことです。\n魔物ではないようですが、いったい: We've received word that an attack is happening here. It doesn't seem to be monsters, but who could it be...
m920021.この愚かな行為の責任を取らぬわけにはいかぬ。\n私の命に免じてオマエたちの命は\: I can't let this foolish act go unpunished. In exchange for my life, I'll spare yours…
m920021.これは失礼しました。\n私は忍者アザミ、あなたがたのお命をいただきたい。: My apologies. I am Ninja Azami, and I wish to claim your lives.
m920021.ご存じですか？\n魔物はあなた方の首に褒賞をかけているのですよ。: Do you know? The monsters have placed a bounty on your heads.
m920021.さあ、英雄の末裔たる王子。\nお相手いただきましょうか。: So, Prince, descendant of heroes. Shall we spar?
m920021.さすがに強い……。\nだが、英雄も毒には勝てないはず。: He's truly strong… Yet even a hero can't withstand poison.
m920021.さすがに手ごわい。\nだからこそ、首を取る価値があるというもの。: He's truly formidable. That's exactly why taking his head is worth it.
m920021.たしかにウソかもしれません。\nしかし、魔物のウソにすがらなければならないほど\: It may well be a lie. But the people are so desperate that they have to cling to the monsters' false promises.
m920021.だが戦いを始めたからには後には引けぬ。\nその力が本物か試させていただく。: But now that the battle has begun, I can't turn back. I'll see if that power is truly real.
m920021.では、出撃を！\n忍者の恐ろしさを味わっていただきましょう。: Then, launch! Let them taste the terror of true ninjas.
m920021.どうやら今回はわれわれの負けのようですね。\n今回はいったん引きますが、またお会: It seems we've lost this round. We'll withdraw for now, but we'll meet again. Until then, stay well—hehe.
m920021.なぜ、忍者がわれわれに敵対するのですか。: Why are the ninjas opposing us?
m920021.なんという強さ……。我々では歯が立ちませんね。\nまさかこれほどとは。\nこうな: Such strength… We can't even get a bite of it. I never imagined it would be this overwhelming. There's nothing we can do now.
m920021.はい！\nすでに村の者が助けを呼びに例の王子のもとへ……。\nほどなくやってくる: Yes! The villagers have already sent for help to the Prince... He should arrive shortly.
m920021.ふふふ、罠とも知らずにな。: Heh, they fall right into our trap.
m920021.まさか、魔物のいう事を信じているのですか？\nウソに決まっています！: You actually believe the monsters? That's a lie, of course!
m920021.ローパーは攻撃力はほとんどないのですが\n触ると体がマヒします。: Loopers have almost no attack power, but touching them will numb your body.
m920021.何でしょうか……。\nなにか嫌な気配がします。\nヌルヌルとしたものに見られてい: What is this…? I feel an unpleasant presence. It's as if something slimy is watching me…
m920021.待ってください！\nあなた方とは戦いたくありません。\n話を聞いてください！: Wait! We don't want to fight you. Please, hear us out!
m920021.正面から戦っては分が悪いですね。\nムササビたちの準備はできていますか？: Charging head-on puts us at a disadvantage. Are the flying squirrels ready?
m920021.毒沼のローパーから採取した\n即効性のマヒ毒を味わっていただきましょう。: Let me give you a taste of the fast-acting paralytic we harvested from the poisonous looper in the toxin swamp.
m920021.英雄の末裔たる王子……。\n血筋だけで祭り上げられているかと思っていましたが、\: Prince, descendant of heroes… I thought you were only celebrated for your bloodline, but perhaps you truly have the power to protect the world from monsters.
m920021.過ちだと気が付いたのなら\nあなた本来の役目を果たすべきです。\n魔物と戦う忍び: If you've realized it was a mistake, you should fulfill your true duty—fight the monsters as a ninja!
m920021.魔物と戦い世界を護るのが忍びのさだめ……。\nなれど、すでに世は魔物の世界！\n: It is the ninja's destiny to fight monsters and protect the world… Yet the world has already become a monster's realm! Half-hearted resistance only brings more suffering.
m920021.魔物の多き戦乱の時世ゆえ、\n私の心も乱れていたのかもしれません。\nこれからは: In these war-torn times swarming with monsters, perhaps my heart was unsettled as well. From now on, I'll uphold the true purpose of a ninja.

m920203.――いんや、訓練はどうやら、終わりのようだ。: ――Hmm, it seems the training is about to end.
m920203.――うぇぇ、模擬戦はもうこりごりにゃぁ～！: ――Ugh, I'm done with these sparring matches!
m920203.――かつて、千年戦争において\n人のために放たれた一筋の流星。:
――Once, in the Millennium War,
a single meteor was released for the sake of humanity.
m920203.――そのとおりだよ。\n王子が神になることを望んでいるやつがいる。:
――You're right.
There are those who want the Prince to become a god.
m920203.――イヨ、あなたの心に迷いがあったのよ。\n救済のためとはいえ、人の命を奪ってい:
??? : ――Iyo, there was hesitation in your heart.
Even for salvation, is it right to take a life?
m920203.――我が巫女たちを愚弄しないでもらおう。\nこの者らは、何代にも渡り、\n神と人:
――Do not mock my shamans.
These individuals have served as bridges between gods and humans
for generations.
m920203.――承知の上よ。\n王子、亜神ディアス討伐は天墜神星さまが引き継ぐ。\n神の悪行:
――I am fully aware.
Prince, the subjugation of the Demon God Dias will be taken over by Amatsu-Mikaboshi-sama.
The crimes of the gods shall be corrected by the gods.
m920203.――東の国の神話はご存知かしら？\n天墜神星さまと、神々の果てなき争いの歴史を。:
――Are you familiar with the myths of the Eastern Kingdom?
The story of Amatsumikaboshi, and the gods' endless war.
m920203.…………こいつは、この気配は、どこかで。: …………This is…… this presence, I've felt it somewhere before.
m920203.…………泣きそうな顔で、言うなよ。\nったく……おい天墜神星ッ！\nてめェ、自分:
…………Don't say that with a face like you're about to cry.
Geez…… hey, Amatsu-Mikaboshi!
If you kill your own shaman, I won't forgive you!!
m920203.……おいおい。\n説明したら襲いかかっていい、\nって言ってるように聞こえるぜ？:
……Wait a minute.
Does that sound like "if she explains it, it's okay to attack"?
m920203.……お見事、さすがは名高き大妖怪、\n山ン本五郎左衛門殿。\nでも残念、あたしは:
??? : ……Well done. You truly live up to your reputation as a great yokai,
Sanmoto Gorozaemon-sama.
But I'm sorry, I'm just a human.
m920203.……しかし、これは天墜神星さまの天命。\nあの者が神と成り果て、\n次なる災禍の:
……But this is Amatsumikaboshi's fate.
I must cut him down before he becomes a god
and becomes the seed of the next calamity.
m920203.……もう、手遅れです。\nヒミコの内側へ、神の膨大な魔力が流れ込んでいます。:
……It's already too late.
A massive amount of divine magic is flowing into Himiko's body.
m920203.……星が、詠めません。\n何が起きて……っ……そんな、星が、渦巻いて、いる？:
……The stars, I cannot read them.
What is happening……! ……No way, the stars, are they, swirling?
m920203.……物質界に降りるのかい？: ……Are you descending into the Material World?
m920203.……王子、あれはあくまで天墜神星の信徒の言い分です。\n人であれ、神であれ、あな:
……Prince, that is merely the argument of Amatsumikaboshi's followers.
Whether human or divine, your essence does not change.
m920203.……神降ろしか！ おい、ちょっと待て！\nヒミコてめェ、さっきの権能だけで倒れか:
……A divine descent! Hey, wait a minute!
Himiko, you were barely standing after using that authority earlier,
if you become a vessel for a god――
m920203.ある人間の救済、それは何を意味しているんだい？: Saving a human… what does that mean?
m920203.いえいえ、これなら大成功の内でしょう。\n拳を交えて真の友となるのは、\n古来よ:
Oh, no, I'd say this is a great success.
Exchanging blows to become true friends
is a tradition of warriors passed down through the ages.
m920203.いやぁ、だって、なぁ？\nどう見たって、あのイヨって小娘のほうが――:
Oh, but, you see?
No matter how you look at it, that girl Iyo is clearly――
m920203.いやいや、お前も大したもんだよ。\nっていうか手抜きしておいて、\nその言い草は:
Oh, come off it. You're quite something yourself.
Besides, you held back, so don't act so high and mighty about it.
m920203.うん、ちょっとある人間を助けるためにね。: Yeah, I'm here to help a certain human.
m920203.えぇ、命を奪う以上、\nその説明はしっかりしなければ。:
Well, since it involves taking a life,
she must explain it properly.
m920203.えぇと……あなたが王国の王子、ね？\nごめんなさい、\nこの子が説明もなく襲いか:
Oh, right……you're the kingdom's Prince, are you?
I'm sorry,
this girl attacked you without any explanation.
m920203.おい王子、どうやらこいつ、\nお前を狙った刺客みたいだが……どうする？:
Hey, Prince. It looks like this one is an assassin targeting you……
What do you say?
m920203.お前んとこは武闘派すぎるのにゃぁ～！！\n第三層「アスガルド」は脳筋しかいないの:
Your place is too obsessed with martial arts!!
The Third Layer, "Asgard," is full of brutes!!
m920203.くっ……これすら、切り抜けますか……。\nっ……はぁっ、はぁ……。:
Tch…… you manage to overcome even this…….
Tch…… haa, haa……
m920203.けれど、世界はそうではない。\n新たな神の存在は、必ずその周囲に争いの火種を生む:
But the world is not so kind.
The existence of a new god will inevitably sow the seeds of conflict around him.
m920203.こいつも、知性派きっての武闘派とか嘘にゃ。\n武闘派中の武闘派にゃ。:
Calling someone like that a "scholarly brawler" is a complete lie.
She's a brawler through and through.
m920203.この世界のため、だよ。\n天墜神星さまは、神の横暴に人が害されぬよう、\n人と神:
It's for the sake of this world.
Amatsu-Mikaboshi-sama wished to separate the worlds of humans and gods
so that people would not be harmed by the gods' tyranny.
m920203.この者がそれを望むことは、ないでしょう。\n天墜神星さまも、王子の人徳は認めてい:
I don't think he would.
Amatsumikaboshi herself acknowledged the Prince's virtue.
m920203.ご心配なく。\nあたしたちは加護を受けているから、\n問題なく通過できるはずだよ:
Don't worry.
We're under divine protection,
so we should be able to pass through without any trouble.
m920203.ご明察。\nさすがは名高き夢の亜神、ヒュープ様。\nというわけで、ここ、通してく:
Sharp observation.
As expected of the renowned Sub-deity of Dreams, Hupe.
So, would you mind letting us through?
m920203.しかし、あれはあくまで鏡像、\n虚空に投影された写し身にすぎぬ。\n転移の力たる:
However, that is merely a mirror image,
a projection cast into the void, nothing more.
It appears to lack the "Divine Radiance" of transposition.
m920203.そいつは傲慢だぜ？\n人間に、人間らしくあるなって言うのは。:
That's pretty arrogant, isn't it?
Telling humans they can't be human.
m920203.そうかよ、この堅物邪神が。\nおい王子、さっさとケリをつけ――ん？\nどうしたソ:
I see, you stubborn evil god.
Hey, Prince, let's wrap this up quick――hmm?
What's with you, Solais? You've got a weird look on your face.
m920203.それでも、よ。\nだからこそ、王子、あなたはここで、\n人である内に命を終えなけ:
Even so.
That is precisely why, Prince, you must end your life
while you are still human.
